subject.title: fix: qmd vector search silently falls back to FTS on first query after gateway restart

question: Is https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98381 sufficient to resolve the qmd mcporter stdout parsing failure tracked here, or should this issue wait for live daemon-warning proof after that PR?
rationale: The source-level parse boundary is real and PR 98381 is a viable candidate, but the originally reported daemon-start contamination path has not been live-proven and prior prefix-filter PRs were rejected as the wrong boundary.

options.title: Review and land PR 98381 first
options.body: Treat the generic non-JSON stdout guard as the current candidate fix, then re-check this issue only if the first-query daemon-warning symptom remains.

options.title: Require live daemon-warning proof first
options.body: Keep PR 98381 separate as hardening and require a live qmd/mcporter first-search reproduction before closing this issue.

recommendation.title: Review and land PR 98381 first
recommendation.body: Treat the generic non-JSON stdout guard as the current candidate fix, then re-check this issue only if the first-query daemon-warning symptom remains.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is the current issue assignee and has recent adjacent qmd query work in the affected path.
